_readme: Hand corrections that always beat the automatic tagging. Read by
sync-youtube.mjs, and `pillarboxed` is read directly by build-pages.mjs.
PILLARBOXED means the video was UPLOADED 16:9 but SHOT vertical, so the real
footage is a 9:16 strip in the middle with black bars either side. Setting it
crops the player to that center strip so the rip presents like every other
one. Do not set it on a genuinely landscape video: it would cut the sides off
